mapper.sql: id, template_no, template_name, template_type, template_category, template_version, template_description, template_content, template_structure, required_sections, optional_sections, template_format, file_size, file_path, preview_path, template_status, is_default, is_enabled, usage_count, download_count, rating_score, rating_count, applicable_projects, industry_scope, complexity_level, estimated_completion_time, template_tags, keywords, author_id, author_name, reviewer_id, reviewer_name, review_date, review_comments, approval_status, approver_id, approver_name, approval_date, approval_comments, last_used_date, maintenance_date, expiry_date, backup_path, change_log, usage_instructions, related_templates, remarks, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE template_no = #{templateNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE template_type = #{templateType} ORDER BY usage_count DESC, create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE is_enabled = 1 AND template_status = 2 ORDER BY usage_count DESC, create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE is_default = 1 AND is_enabled = 1 ORDER BY template_type, create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE usage_count >= #{minUsageCount} AND is_enabled = 1 ORDER BY usage_count DESC, rating_score DESC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(SYSDATE, INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND is_enabled = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE template_status = #{templateStatus} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE approval_status = #{approvalStatus} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE reviewer_id = #{reviewerId} ORDER BY review_date DESC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE approver_id = #{approverId} ORDER BY approval_date DESC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE rating_score >= #{minRatingScore} AND rating_count >= 5 AND is_enabled = 1 ORDER BY rating_score DESC, rating_count DESC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE last_used_date >= DATE_SUB(SYSDATE, INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND is_enabled = 1 ORDER BY last_used_date DESC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND expiry_date BETWEEN SYSDATE AND SYSDATE + #{days} ORDER BY expiry_date ASC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE maintenance_date IS NOT NULL AND maintenance_date <= SYSDATE ORDER BY maintenance_date ASC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE complexity_level = #{complexityLevel} AND is_enabled = 1 ORDER BY usage_count DESC

SELECT
FROM bid_template WHERE industry_scope LIKE CONCAT('%', #{industryScope}, '%') AND is_enabled = 1 ORDER BY usage_count DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE bid_template SET usage_count = usage_count + 1, last_used_date = SYSDATE, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bid_template SET download_count = download_count + 1, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bid_template SET rating_score = #{ratingScore}, rating_count = rating_count + 1, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
